title: Onion Chilli Cheese Omlette

items: 1 eggs + 2 egg whites + salt + pepper to taste +1 tbsp milk

caption:
Onion Chilli Cheese Omlette 
Boost your protein | Easy breakfast | Satisfying brunch | One-pan wonder

Nutrition: 
C: 10 | F: 14 | P: 20
Calories: 241 per serve without bread 
Serves 1

Ingredients
one spray of olive oil 
1 eggs + 2 egg whites + salt + pepper to taste +1 tbsp milk
1/2 onion, finely chopped
2 green chillies, finely chopped ( use one if you dont want it to be mad spicy )
20 grams cheese, grated or sliced ( i used cheddar here ) 

serve as is or with a slice of toast 

Method 
spray oil in the pan 
add in onions and chillies and the green capsicum with some salt and pepper to taste
in another bowl, add in the eggs + 1 tbsp milk + salt & pepper and whisk together
add the mix to the pan and allow to cook then flip it over
add the cheese and fold it
